name: multi-repo
problem: Archi assumes spec and code share one repository: one tree scanned, one commit as the audit's delta source, bare root-relative anchors. Real projects spread code across repositories and the spec lives alone, where capture sees no code, the audit anchors a code-less tree, and a link cannot name a file outside the root. Split-tree-pressure fixed the failure shapes before code: absence must not decay the record (the checkout that stayed home), a post-hoc baseline must confess its window (the baseline recorded too late), git paths must be rebased into the member's frame (the monorepo that was already broken), identity keys survive remaps and collisions (the renamed member, two repos one path, the wave that outlived its map). The single-repo project stays the unmarked case, byte for byte.

technology_stack.tech: Rust 2024; crates/archi: members.rs (new — declarations via the compiler's manifest reader, local mapping overlay, resolution to roots + git top-levels, reachability survey), versions.rs (per-member baselines, anchor --repo), links/mod.rs (member-qualified anchors, Unreachable grade, per-member audit), links/capture.rs (mapped-set scan, scan set in the index), main.rs (repo verb, --repo flags)
technology_stack.provenance: members.rs sits beside links and versions exactly where tool.arch places Members between SourceTree and its consumers; the manifest schema extends the one reader (init-honors-the-manifest precedent)

technology_stack.tech: manifest: [[repo]] name/url/path in archi.toml; archi/repos.local.toml (gitignored) for machine mappings; version entries gain commits = {member = {sha, born}}; journal Anchor/Span gain optional repo field
technology_stack.provenance: identity committed, mapping local — split-tree-pressure's renamed-member and checkout-that-stayed-home both press this seam; append-only journal forbids any rewrite (one-repo-stays-the-default)

technology_stack.tech: git via std::process::Command as today, plus rev-parse --show-toplevel per consulted root and path rebasing into the member frame
technology_stack.provenance: git-speaks-from-its-own-root: the rebase sits under every git read; home rides the same code path, fixing the nested-root mismatch

architecture_summary.role: the one resolution: manifest declarations under local overrides to roots, git top-levels and reachability; home implicit; every scan and baseline consults it (Links.locate, Links.locate_scan, Archive.locate)

the member dimension end to end: refs parse and render member//file#symbol with unqualified = home, the Grader grades Unreachable upstream of Missing and audits each member against its own baseline, Capture scans the mapped set and records it in the wave index
provenance as a set: save baselines every clean mapped member and reports omissions; anchor --repo records post hoc with its birth marked; entries without the table replay unchanged
the repo verb (ls, map) and --repo scoping on verify, audit, anchor; nothing above the trace layer learns about members

stack_mapping.tech: crates/archi/src/members.rs; [[repo]] schema in crates/modeling-lang/src/source/project.rs; repo ls/map in main.rs
crates/archi/src/links/mod.rs (Anchor.repo, parse/render, Unreachable, per-member audit, exclude scoping), links/capture.rs (mapped-set scan, scan set in the index)
crates/archi/src/versions.rs (commits table, per-member clean-head through members' git context, anchor --repo)

scenarios: two members: declare + map a second repo, link add backend//src/lib.rs#item, verify Clean, edit the item, verify Drifted — qualified end to end
spec-only home: a project whose code all lives in one member — save records the member baseline, capture attributes a wave's delta, audit tags findings backend//…
absence: unmap the member, verify grades its links Unreachable with no decay events journaled; verify --repo backend exits nonzero
late baseline: save with the member dirty, commit the member, anchor --repo — the entry marks the post-hoc birth and audit names the unaudited span
nested home: a project rooted below its git root audits with rebased paths (the pre-existing mismatch, fixed)
single-repo regression: the full existing suite green; a memberless project's verify/audit/save output byte-identical to v0011 behavior

tasks.description: the member registry: [[repo]] in the manifest through the compiler's reader, archi/repos.local.toml overlay, resolution to roots + git top-levels with reachability, the repo ls/map verbs
tasks.stack_details: new crates/archi/src/members.rs: MemberSet::resolve(root) reads manifest [[repo]] (name/url/path, deny-unknown-fields in project.rs beside [project]) then overlays archi/repos.local.toml ({member = "dir"}); each member resolves to Option<root> (unreachable when the dir or its git top-level is absent); home is member "" with the project root; every member carries git_top: rev-parse --show-toplevel resolved lazily, paths rebased member-frame; survey() renders name/root/reachable/clean/head/baseline; repo ls prints it, repo map writes the overlay row; .gitignore gains archi/*.local.toml via init and this repo's own file

a-dark-corpus-stays-partial: unit: resolution reads manifest and overlay alone — no doc corpus read, a tree with unreadable docs resolves identically
a-late-baseline-says-so: unit: survey renders the baseline column from the latest entry verbatim — birth shown as recorded, never recomputed
absence-is-not-drift: unit: resolve returns unreachable as a per-member value, never an error — no caller can panic on absence
candidates-carry-signal: unit: MemberSet keys are names and files stay bare in its API — the qualifier cannot leak into term extraction
capture-at-the-join: unit: resolution is a pure read — no members verb mutates plan state; the scan set is capture's to record
dark-deltas-are-code: unit: members exposes roots unfiltered — the exclusion boundary keeps one owner in the scans
drift-graded-per-kind: unit: resolution output is kind-blind — roots and reachability carry no link kind
findings-never-block: unit: repo ls on a half-mapped set exits 0 — absence is reported, never an error
git-speaks-from-its-own-root: unit: a member whose root sits below its git top-level carries the prefix and rebases a git-root-relative path into member frame; home nested below its git root rebases the same way
members-are-declared: unit: a declared member with no checkout resolves unreachable and repo ls says so; a local row overrides the manifest path; url never resolves anything
merge-deltas-are-reviewable: unit: the overlay is gitignored and never merged; [[repo]] rows are one line per member so manifest merges diff member-local
one-repo-stays-the-default: unit: no [[repo]] and no overlay resolves to home alone — the set is today's single root
one-verb-searches-everything: unit: member names mint no cards — search over a membered project returns the memberless corpus
one-verb-stands-a-project-up: unit: init scaffolds memberless and ignores archi/*.local.toml — the cold start never meets the registry
parallel-editing-discipline: unit: overlays are per-machine and resolution persists nothing — two mappings of one member cannot race in git
provenance-anchors-post-hoc: unit: the home anchor guarantee reads through members only for git context — clean + render-match inputs unchanged
provenance-goes-per-member: unit: resolve surfaces per member exactly what a save baselines on — mapped and clean, judged in that member's git context
refs-carry-their-repo: unit: a declared name must be ref-safe — separators, `#`, `//` and whitespace refuse at parse with the grammar named
remint-rejoins-the-lineage: unit: remint reads no member state — a membered project remints as before
scans-see-every-mapped-member: unit: resolve returns every declared member exactly once, mapped or not — an iterating scan cannot silently skip one
stress-pins-versions: unit: affects resolve against pinned versions untouched by [[repo]] — stress surfaces are registry-blind
the-archive-is-sealed: unit: members.rs writes only the overlay — nothing lands under archi/versions/, the seal untouched
unchanged-saves-close-rounds: unit: repo map changes no render — a following save still reports nothing to save and still closes a round
versions-mint-on-meaning: unit: registry and overlay live outside canonical(project) — identical models with different registries hash identical

tasks.description: the member dimension through links: qualified refs, Unreachable upstream of Missing, the mapped-set wave scan with its scan set recorded, the per-member audit and exclude boundary
tasks.stack_details: links/mod.rs: Anchor/Span gain repo: Option<String> (serde default; None = home), Anchor::parse/display speak member//file#symbol; resolve_anchor and every root.join goes through MemberSet; check_link grades Unreachable before Missing — no touch/decay events for unscanned members, audit --prune skips them; verify/audit gain --repo <member> (absence inside the asked scope exits nonzero); delta_hunks/changed_files run per member via its git context, rebased; scan_exclusions: bare patterns all members, member//prefix scoped; capture.rs: TreeIndex::scan walks every mapped member into qualified keys, the index header records the scan set, capture diffs exactly that set and notes members outside it; candidate search and code_files take the member walk

dark-deltas-are-code: unit: bare exclude pattern applies in every member, member//-prefixed in exactly its member; built-ins stay home-only and a nested archi.toml subtree in a member is skipped

findings-never-block: unit: unreachable and recovery notes are findings — verify and audit exit 0 on them outside an explicit --repo scope

one-repo-stays-the-default: e2e: memberless project — bare keys, bare anchors, today's outputs byte for byte; the existing links/capture test suite green unchanged

tasks.description: provenance as a set: one baseline per clean mapped member at save, anchor --repo post hoc with its birth marked, the audit window worded per member
tasks.stack_details: versions.rs: Entry gains commits: BTreeMap<String, Baseline> {sha, born: save|anchor} (absent = today's entry; commit field untouched for home); save consults MemberSet, records each clean member's head through its git context and reports omissions; anchor keeps the home guarantee (clean + render-hash match) and --repo <member> records a missing member baseline under clean-tree alone, born=anchor, re-anchor reports no-op; latest_version_commit generalizes to per-member delta sources consumed by links' audit; main.rs wires --repo
